title: Another part of my 'Dreaming'...
content: Last night I visited a place in my dreaming I hadn't been to in a while. There's this massive colourful outdoor City market (which is sometimes attached to a festival ...but I think that's seasonal), and if you go deep into tyeaze.of stands and tents, kiosks and buildings, you get to this massive charity shop/thrift store that is full of everything you could ever want. Last night I was there (with my partner again) and I bought a 'Big Brother and The Holding Company' tie-died t shirt, lol! Nice.
